## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] Touched files keep the surrounding style (comment density, naming, idiom)
- [ ] New cognitive-substrate behavior is documented + cited (see `docs/COGNITIVE_SUBSTRATE.md`, `docs/CITATIONS.md`) — or N/A
- [ ] Commit message follows the `vX.Y.Z — short summary` convention
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or local state (`bots/`, `logs/`, `keys.json`) included
